label: Root links from Hannes Leitgeb and André Carus, Rudolf Carnap
summary: §7, "Quine rejected Carnap’s internal/external distinction, which in Quine’s view relied on an analytic/synthetic distinction": The existing Quine objection to Carnap is attached through Carnap’s internal/external distinction. The report disputes the analytic/synthetic dependency, and the same entry records a reply challenging that reconstruction. The relation supplies no evidence by itself of a defect in the case’s own existence claim.
